title: Make swarm fixtures native
goal: Repair native swarm fixtures and the Windows descendant-termination ordering they exposed. Keep taskkill scoped to the owned root tree before the direct-child fallback, remove unscoped MSYS orphan cleanup, preserve Unix behavior, and prove that an unrelated owned sibling remains alive.
acceptance: All susi-gawd-swarm library tests pass on native Windows without sh/ps/kill in PATH; both persisted DAG mutation cases preserve exact bytes and conflict evidence, and the cancellation regression observes a live identified descendant become exited through the real production runner.
progress: Native Windows red/green is verified. Original DAG fixtures: 3 passed, 2 failed; original shell cancellation: 1 failed. Strict creation-time-bound descendant probe first failed because the real child survived, then passed after the Windows-only termination-order fix. Final library acceptance: 424 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored. The unrelated test-owned sibling survives cancellation. Strict affected-crate Clippy and architecture/orphan/source-ceiling/docs guards passed. Independent exact-source review is complete. Combined-tree reconciliation of the reduced swarm production source ceiling belongs to its separate scope owner, and serialized integration remains pending; no release or publication is claimed.

guard_tests.method: Unmodified repository test sources compiled with pinned native rustc and matching Cargo-built dependency artifacts, then executed in isolated homes

verification.integration: Independent exact-source review approved local commit; pending separate-owner production source ceiling reconciliation and serialized combined-tree gate.
